pitches.title: Maternal danger follow-up that cannot vanish: fix the 'later complaint clears the danger' bug, and keep it urgent until a Kader records contact and outcome
pitches.job: Make sure a reported pregnancy danger sign stays at the top until someone has contacted the mother and she has been seen by a bidan or Puskesmas
pitches.outcome: Fewer maternal danger signs lost (bleeding, eclampsia, ruptured membranes) between report and care; the thesis can measure the median minutes from report to contact and the share with a recorded outcome
pitches.evidence: backend/app/routers/maternal.py:138-141 and :173 take the latest PregnancyDangerReport whatever its danger flag, so a later common complaint (ai/maternal.py:50 COMMON_COMPLAINTS) clears urgency at once, and urgency also expires silently after 3 days; maternal.py:401 notifies only Kaders; models.py:506-514 has no contacted/outcome fields; the Kader pregnancy page (mobile/src/app/pregnancy/[id]/index.tsx) shows no report time or sign
pitches.smallest_version: Base urgency on the latest danger=True report; add contacted_at, contacted_by_id and outcome via _ADDED_COLUMNS; PATCH /api/pregnancies/{pid}/danger/{rid} for staff only, queued offline; the mother stays 'Risiko tinggi' until an outcome is recorded; a Kader card on the pregnancy page with 'Sudah saya hubungi' and 'Sudah diperiksa bidan/Puskesmas'; notify the doctor too. Push and timed escalation are cut
pitches.risks: Touches the offline outbox (new kind) and the mother risk logic, so the data-ai-engineer must sign off; the mother's call-first danger screen must stay unchanged; urgency without expiry needs an outcome path for staff; it adds a feature check and may disturb the 81 checks; files: models.py, database.py, routers/maternal.py, schemas.py, pregnancy/[id]/index.tsx, PregnancyParts.tsx, lib/offline.ts, types.ts, i18n.ts, test_maternal.py, features.e2e.mjs, USER_GUIDE.md

pitches.title: Kader or Puskesmas resets a mother's forgotten password, as the app already promises
pitches.job: Get a locked-out mother (often phone-only, with a temporary password read to her once) back into the app the same day
pitches.outcome: Mothers keep access to danger-sign reporting, check-up schedules and Puskesmas results; the share of locked-out accounts can be measured from audit logs
pitches.evidence: mobile/src/app/login.tsx:139 and mobile/src/lib/i18n.ts:1491 'Minta kata sandi baru ke Kader atau Puskesmas.', docs/USER_GUIDE.md:53; backend/app/routers/auth.py has only register, login, me, users (admin) and change-password, which needs the current password (:147); there is no reset anywhere in routers/ or cli.py; phone-only mothers get an 8-digit temporary password once (routers/maternal.py:268)
pitches.smallest_version: POST /api/kader/mothers/{id}/reset-password, for caregivers in the Kader's coverage or for the officer, doctor or admin; it reuses the temporary-password code at maternal.py:261-270, bumps token_version, writes an audit entry and notifies the mother; a staff-only button in the care-team section of the pregnancy page shows the new code once
pitches.risks: Account takeover by staff: limit it to caregivers in coverage, audit every reset, never reset staff accounts; the token_version bump signs out the shared phone, and queued outbox items must survive (d9e8d3a says they do; to verify); impact on outcomes is indirect; files: routers/maternal.py, test_security.py, test_maternal.py, pregnancy/[id]/index.tsx, i18n.ts, features.e2e.mjs, USER_GUIDE.md

pitches.title: Overdue vaccines, vitamin A and deworming on the Kader's priority list, with a filter for posyandu day
pitches.job: Before posyandu day, see which children are overdue for immunisation, vitamin A or deworming without opening each child
pitches.outcome: Higher basic immunisation and vitamin A coverage (Kemenkes specific interventions against infection-driven growth faltering); measurable as the share of children with no overdue KIA item per village
pitches.evidence: backend/app/routers/dashboard.py:196-262 area_children rows have no KIA field, and its filters are region, risk, not_measured_days, needs_visit and q; mobile/src/components/KaderHome.tsx:221-228 chips; live: 12 of the 23 children of kader.oesapa have 2-9 overdue items via GET /api/children/{id}/kia (for example Budi's PCV 3), and the '> 30 hari' filter returns 0 on the fresh demo because every child was measured today
pitches.smallest_version: Compute kia_overdue (the count and the first item label) per row with the existing ai/kia.schedule and one KiaRecord query; add a kia_overdue=true filter; a chip 'Imunisasi/Vit A terlewat' and a row line 'Terlewat: PCV 3 · bawa ke Posyandu'
pitches.risks: No new clinical rule (it reuses the kia.py windows), but the 'terlewat' wording must not alarm; a small cost per list load; cached offline through useApi as today; files: routers/dashboard.py, KaderHome.tsx, types.ts, i18n.ts, tests/test_api.py, features.e2e.mjs, USER_GUIDE.md

keep.why: Danger signs already lead to Puskesmas, 119 and Kader buttons even with no signal, and each report is sent once (client_uuid); this is the safety core

keep.feature: WHO rules, triage, cases and Kader alerts that run without the AI consent (backend/app/routers/children.py:232)
keep.why: Safety no longer depends on the optional Claude consent; only the language-model text is gated

keep.feature: Doctor referral shown on the child result (mobile/src/components/AssessmentView.tsx:66, doctorSoon)

keep.feature: Offline outbox with lock, idempotent replay and the sync screen (mobile/src/lib/offline.ts, app/sync.tsx; commits d9e8d3a, 0873da2, 7d0b5cd)
